decision: Not registered. Root PM assigns the EXP-P24 ID only after review and smoke; no real-data fit or scoring before that.
matrix_row: E4 / MX-F6 (direct head context without workload -> with observed workload scalars; never run before)
hypothesis: Adding fixed observed-workload scalars (Statcast records earlier in the game; times through order and rest) to the direct pre-pitch head changes its 2025 DEV outcome distribution relative to the frozen EXP-P15-001 head, alone and in the fixed 1/2 mix with G0-global.
one_change: Extra context scalars inserted before the 7 sharing columns. Everything else is EXP-P15-001: current-pitch physics zero, uniform loss, flatten MLP 128, budget, May 1-15 early stop, May 16-31 Cpanel temperature, June Cpanel frequency blend, Cpanel DEV and frozen whole-MLB DEV.
variant_rule: Two pre-fixed variants, defined by the root before any outcome evaluation; no feature HPO and no definition change from results. All 2 variants x 3 seeds fit and predict before any comparison.

feature_rules.rebuild: pitchmdp/workload_features.rebuild (d2e2484) over ALL raw records of the allowlist, before eligibility/cohort filters; aligned to frozen parent rows by exact (game_pk, at_bat_number, pitch_number) with date and pitcher equality
feature_rules.prior_records_per100: Statcast records of the same pitcher earlier in the same game_pk (current excluded) / 100, unclipped. Observed record count, may include automatic non-pitch events; not physiological fatigue
feature_rules.thruorder_minus1_over3: (rebuilt_thruorder - 1) / 3; rebuilt_thruorder = PAs faced earlier in this game by this pitcher // 9 + 1
feature_rules.log_rest_days: log1p(clip(days since this pitcher's previous earlier date in the loaded raw, 0, rest_cap_days)) / log(rest_cap_days + 1); missing -> 0; same-day previous game omitted by definition
feature_rules.rest_missing: 1 if no earlier date for the pitcher in the loaded 2023-2025 raw records, else 0
feature_rules.savant_workload_columns: never read by the model path (audit only, PM-WORKLOAD-TRAIN-AUDIT-20261003.json)

future_confirmation: Seeds 3 and 4 only in a separate registered confirmation after root review.

mix.rule: candidate direct head and the frozen G0-global member of the same seed, member-wise 1/2, then the same June frequency blend; compared with the frozen G15 mix (EXP-P15-002 construction) of the same seeds

unchanged_from_p15.splits: EXP-P4-001 train / earlystop / temperature (May Cpanel) / blend (June Cpanel) / dev (Cpanel) keys; frozen mlb_dev
unchanged_from_p15.calibration: per-seed temperature on the May Cpanel rows (same optimizer and bounds), three-seed probability mean, June frequency blend by the same scorer
unchanged_from_p15.device: auto (mps on the Mac mini, same as the control)
unchanged_from_p15.not_changed_here: no recency loss weight (P20 found no NLL gain), no PLR/periodic embedding

data_rules: No 2026 rows or files (allowlist + runner date guards). Feature path reads keys/date/pitcher only; no outcome, description, physics or Savant workload column. Frozen row sets and train/May/June/DEV split unchanged. DEV never used for fitting, calibration or selection.

metrics.primary_descriptive: Cpanel DEV after the June frequency blend: candidate direct vs frozen EXP-P15-001 direct, candidate mix vs frozen G15 mix, paired NLL/Brier with whole-game bootstrap, per-seed deltas
secondary_descriptive: Cpanel DEV before the frequency blend
whole-MLB DEV calibrated three-seed mean (no June blend) when --mlb was run
TRAIN feature distribution and parameter counts (from preparation/fit)

exposure_note: Cpanel and whole-MLB DEV were read repeatedly (P7-003, P11, P13-P16). Results are development comparisons, not confirmation. Two variants form a search; any later selection must be labelled after-search.

order: run  : --output <runs>/<registered id> run --variant <v> --seeds 0 1 2 --mlb   (each of counts, block)
score: --output <runs>/<registered id> score   (only after all 6 fits; writes analysis/descriptive.json only)
execution.device: --device auto (mps on the Mac mini, same as the control); cpu/cuda runs are not comparable to the MPS control without a same-device control arm
execution.queue: single heavy queue runs/ML-MATRIX-20260924/.heavy.lock; Mac mini MPS first
